strategies.name: HYG_LQD_CREDIT_SPREAD_MOM
strategies.thesis: Credit spread momentum can improve Sharpe ratio by capturing changes in credit market conditions.
strategies.signal_construction: Calculate the 6-month momentum of the HYG-LQD spread and select the top ETF based on this signal.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Incorporates credit spread momentum to enhance the existing HYG/LQD momentum strategy.
strategies.fail_mode: Insufficient data quality or incorrect signal construction.

strategies.name: DURATION_ROTATION
strategies.thesis: Duration rotation can improve Sharpe ratio by adapting to changes in interest rate environments.
strategies.signal_construction: Calculate the 12-month moving average of the 10-year Treasury yield and rotate between short-duration (SHY) and long-duration (TLT) ETFs based on this signal.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Incorporates duration rotation to enhance the existing momentum strategy.
strategies.fail_mode: Incorrect signal construction or insufficient data quality.

strategies.name: CREDIT_SPREAD_DURATION_HYBRID
strategies.thesis: Combining credit spread and duration signals can improve Sharpe ratio by capturing multiple market factors.
strategies.signal_construction: Calculate the 6-month momentum of the HYG-LQD spread and the 12-month moving average of the 10-year Treasury yield, and select the top ETF based on a combination of these signals.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Incorporates both credit spread and duration signals to enhance the existing momentum strategy.
strategies.fail_mode: Insufficient data quality, incorrect signal construction, or overfitting.

duration_overlay_proposals: Short-duration vs long-duration regime based on 10-year Treasury yield
killers: Existing live BOND emitter with PF below 1.0
single_most_important_finding: Combining credit spread and duration signals can significantly improve the Sharpe ratio of the BOND asset class.
